results.name: Electronic Code Lock
results.description:
Game-ready electronic keypad code lock designed for survival, military, industrial, and post-apocalyptic game environments.

The model features a worn metal body, numbered keypad, six-digit password display, illuminated status indicators, and separate confirm and cancel buttons. It can be used as an interactive security device or as an environmental prop for doors, gates, bunkers, bases, storage containers, and restricted areas.

The asset is optimized for real-time rendering and suitable for FPS, survival, horror, and post-apocalyptic games.

FEATURES:

• Game-ready optimized model
• Detailed electronic keypad
• Six-digit password display
• Red cancel and green confirm buttons
• Worn and weathered metal appearance
• Clean UV mapping
• Suitable for first-person and third-person games
• Can be used as an interactive object or environment prop


Do not use in the game Dayz

results.name: Titov Bunker Konjic - Furnace (Scaniverse)
results.description:
Titov Bunker, or ARK D-0, is a Cold War-era nuclear shelter located near Konjic, Bosnia and Herzegovina. Built in secrecy between 1953 and 1979, it was intended to safeguard President Josip Broz Tito and 350 top Yugoslav officials for up to six months in the event of nuclear war. The facility, costing over $4.6 billion, lies 280 meters inside Mount Zlatar and spans over 6,500 square meters with 100 rooms. It featured advanced (for the time) air filtration, power generation, and communication systems. Today, it's a historical monument and educational site, hosting art exhibitions and teaching about Cold War geopolitics.

[Bosnia and Herzegovina Scans Collection](https://skfb.ly/p88Jt)
